outputs.description: List of output names to restrict autotiling to

workspaces.description: List of workspace numbers or names to restrict autotiling to

limit.description: Maximum number of splits per container (0 = no limit)

splitwidth.description: Width factor for vertical splits (e.g., 1.0 = default)

splitheight.description: Height factor for horizontal splits (e.g., 1.0 = default)

splitratio.description: Split direction ratio: split horizontally if window width/height > ratio; e.g., 1.61 for golden ratio

events.description: List of events that trigger split orientation change
